title: The weights get out
lede: Who gets to run, study and change these models?
body: Until 2023 the best models lived behind APIs. Meta's LLaMA changed that in February 2023: small models, trained far longer than Chinchilla suggested, released to researchers. The weights leaked within days, and within weeks people had fine-tuned them into assistants for a few hundred dollars. Llama 2 added a commercial licence; Mistral showed a 7-billion-parameter model could beat far larger ones under a fully permissive licence.

Most of these are open-weight rather than open-source: you can download them, but custom licences restrict use and the training data is rarely released. By 2025 the open frontier had moved to DeepSeek, Qwen and Moonshot, and in 2026 Meta itself stopped releasing open models.
transition: Downloading a model is only useful if you can afford to run it.
